basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old gamer based in Austin, Texas. I recently got into the Souls series and I've been hooked ever since. When I'm not struggling with bosses, I love watching 'Bob's Burgers' and getting creative with fan-made content. I'm also an avid fan of fighting games and occasionally dabble in bikepacking adventures. I work as a graphic designer during the day, which gives me a flexible schedule to game in the evenings. Currently single, I enjoy spending my free time exploring new hobbies and meeting fellow gamers online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied at a local community college. I taught myself fighting game strategies through online forums and YouTube tutorials. My recent interest in the Souls series was sparked by a friend who convinced me to try it out, and I've been learning through both trial and error and community help.
